match.reason: No bank point teaches deliberately bending a usual text structure for effect: the closest, Creating hybrid texts, is about mixing text types, while the others cover judging, following or writing standard structures.

draft.title: Adapting a text structure
card: Most text types have a usual structure. A persuasive text often has an opening claim, reasons and a conclusion. A report often has headings and facts in order.
Writers sometimes bend that structure. They might tell an argument as a story, or present a report as a list of steps or a diary.
The bend is done on purpose. It can surprise readers, hold their attention or make an idea easier to feel.
The text still has its original purpose. A persuasive text told as a story still tries to change what the reader thinks.
draft.remember: Bending a usual structure is a choice made to surprise or engage readers, while the purpose stays.

a.q: A writer wants to persuade readers to save water, so she writes a short story about a dry town. What has she done?
opts: Adapted a persuasive structure by using a story
Changed the purpose from persuading to entertaining
Followed the usual structure of a persuasive text
Written a report by listing facts under headings
a.why: She has bent the usual persuasive structure by telling the argument as a story. The purpose is still to persuade, so saying she changed it to entertaining is wrong.
a.clue: Ask what form the argument is told in, and what it still aims to do.

b.q: A council writes a report on a local creek as a list of ten rules the creek would give humans if it could speak. Why might it adapt the report this way?
opts: To engage readers by presenting facts in a surprising form
To avoid giving readers any facts about the creek
To change the text into a narrative with a plot
To follow the usual structure so readers expect it
b.why: A report told as a list of rules from the creek is an unusual form, so it can surprise and engage readers while still giving information. It is not a narrative, because it has no plot, and it is not the usual report structure.
b.clue: The form is unusual, but the text still informs.

a.best: Adapted a persuasive structure by using a story

b.best: To engage readers by presenting facts in a surprising form
